sentences.en: Their communication may be much more complex than we thought.
sentences.zh: 他们的交流可能比我们想象的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Through communication we are able to learn about each other.
sentences.zh: 通过交流，我们可以相互了解。

sentences.en: Language is one of the most important ways of communication.
sentences.zh: 语言是最重要的交流方式之一。

senses.zh: 交流，沟通；通讯，通信；传达，传播
